internalEvidence: Pegasus Spiele's English two-page booklet was retrieved from its official download for inventory BGG identity 299630. Printed/PDF page 2 was rendered and visually checked. Official PDF SHA-256: 06b59c11a4890ebd442bc87d849b8bdaa2a5b0169bda826e461743918fc62077. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
